svg.title: HTTP/1.1: a status line, header lines, an empty line
svg.desc: The HTTP response of frame 30 of arppoison.pcapng, 32 bits per row: the status line, the version HTTP/1.1, a space, the three-digit code 204, a space, the reason phrase No Content and CR LF, then the header line Content-Length: 0, six more header lines, and the empty line that ends the head; HttpResponse keeps the version, the status code, the reason, the seven headers and an empty body.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
